sources.snippet: Lowdown Labs builds the world's most efficient AI. Powerful models with a clean conscience: fair to artists, kind to the planet, radically transparent.

sources.title: Lowdown Labs - GitHub
sources.snippet: The world's most efficient sub quadratic coding model. FELA is built for long context engineering work that stays on your machine, fast even on CPU inference. Open weights with quantized variants, available to self deploy and via API, and chat + coding instruct tuning is on the way. The architecture is documented in our research record on Zenodo.
